_description: Single source of truth for the add-on's version. Everything user-facing that shows a version reads from here (see `surfaces`), and `test/ui/version-manifest.test.js` fails if any of them drift. Update this file in the same commit as the release, never separately.
_versioning: The add-on is on the 2.0 line: every release, whatever it contains, bumps the build (the third number), so MINOR stays 0. docs/versioning.md has the policy; CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md list every copy of the version and what keeps it in sync.
_prefsSchemaVersion: Must equal PREFS_SCHEMA_CURRENT_ in apps-script/migrations.gs. This is the user-data schema, not the add-on version: it only ever increases, and it increases whenever a new preference key ships. A mismatch means either a migration landed without a version bump or the reverse — both leave upgrading users in a state no migration covers.
_surfaces: Every place the version string is shown to a user. An agent bumping the version must update all of them; the manifest test checks they agree.

surfaces.note: About tab meta-pill. Shows the full version, build included: on the 2.0 line the build is the only number that moves.
About tab: what the current release changed. A release rewrites the list under it.
Shown on install and from the release-notes dialog.

_docs: Every doc that names the current version (and, where it says so, the preference schema), outside the user-facing surfaces: the version under demo or test, and the release steps. The manifest test checks each one like a surface, and checks a `schema N` in it against prefsSchemaVersion. A doc that is a dated record (a CHANGELOG heading, a past release's live test checklist, a design doc's target) is not listed: it keeps the number it was written for.

docs.shows: The version under demo is **2.0.1, preference schema 30**

This goes further than [`docs/live-test-checklist-2.0.1.md`](../live-test-checklist-2.0.1.md).
That checklist asks whether each 2.0.1 change landed.
clasp version "v2.0.1"      # prints the new version number

_changelog: docs/CHANGELOG.md must carry a heading for this version once status is 'released'. While 'pending-release' the entries live under 'Unreleased' headings and get consolidated at release time.
_deployment: Apps Script has no manifest version field — appsscript.json carries no version. `clasp push` replaces the script project's HEAD, which only test deployments run. Users run the numbered script version (from `clasp version`) that the Marketplace SDK App Configuration points to, so a release is: live-test HEAD, `clasp version`, set that number in the SDK. Neither Apps Script version numbers nor the SDK record which add-on version a number corresponds to — this file, together with the `clasp version` description (use `v<version>`), is the only record, which is exactly why it must not drift.
